## BigDecimal

Operands of *digits* decimal digits at working *precision*, so that
precision grows with the operands. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter. `round` drops the
low half of the operand; `parse` builds the value from its string.

Verified this run: decimo and libmpdec produce the same
2000-digit product from the same 1000-digit operands.

| Digits / precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 / 28 | add | 39.7 ns | 32.1 ns | 1.23× slower | 46.2 ns | **1.16× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | subtract | 42.1 ns | 32.3 ns | 1.30× slower | 45.3 ns | **1.08× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | multiply | 39.5 ns | 27.8 ns | 1.42× slower | 43.4 ns | **1.10× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | divide | 146.6 ns | 50.1 ns | 2.92× slower | 67.0 ns | 2.19× slower |
| 9 / 28 | round | 37.3 ns | 32.1 ns | 1.16× slower | 69.9 ns | **1.87× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | parse | 89.6 ns | 40.0 ns | 2.24× slower | 78.3 ns | 1.15× slower |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen. `2.3456789`, and
`** 1.5` for power. 100 000 digits is left out because `mpd_exp`
needs 82 seconds there and `mpd_ln` 239 seconds.

| Precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.51 µs | 853.8 ns | 2.94× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.03 µs | 4.41 µs | **1.09× faster** |
| 28 | ln | 4.32 µs | 12.34 µs | **2.86× faster** |
| 28 | power | 10.64 µs | 34.14 µs | **3.21× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.37 µs | 4.04 µs | 1.08× slower |
| 100 | exp | 9.92 µs | 14.47 µs | **1.46× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 66.32 µs | 38.31 µs | 1.73× slower |
| 100 | power | 86.76 µs | 77.85 µs | 1.11× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 52.41 µs | 214.12 µs | **4.09× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 382.46 µs | 4.44 ms | **11.62× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.81 ms | 5.55 ms | **1.98× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.24 ms | 11.20 ms | **3.46× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 1.16 ms | 23.21 ms | **19.97× faster** |
| 10,000 | exp | 49.43 ms | 1.345 s | **27.22× faster** |
| 10,000 | ln | 255.60 ms | 3.182 s | **12.45× faster** |
| 10,000 | power | 304.95 ms | 4.561 s | **14.96× faster** |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.
Division is 2n-by-n; two operands of the same width would give a
one-digit quotient and measure nothing.

| Digits | Operation | decimo | CPython `int` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | add | 36.5 ns | 25.9 ns | 1.41× slower |
| 100 | multiply | 80.7 ns | 103.1 ns | **1.28× faster** |
| 100 | floor divide | 445.1 ns | 302.7 ns | 1.47× slower |
| 100 | sqrt | 468.9 ns | 305.3 ns | 1.54× slower |
| 1,000 | add | 52.2 ns | 93.6 ns | **1.79× faster** |
| 1,000 | multiply | 1.14 µs | 5.34 µs | **4.70× faster** |
| 1,000 | floor divide | 8.87 µs | 12.34 µs | **1.39× faster** |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 4.02 µs | 4.36 µs | **1.09× faster** |
| 10,000 | add | 265.0 ns | 763.8 ns | **2.88× faster** |
| 10,000 | multiply | 54.77 µs | 259.39 µs | **4.74× faster** |
| 10,000 | floor divide | 177.47 µs | 534.38 µs | **3.01× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 108.95 µs | 263.26 µs | **2.42× faster** |
| 100,000 | add | 2.45 µs | 7.82 µs | **3.19× faster** |
| 100,000 | multiply | 1.16 ms | 8.69 ms | **7.46× faster** |
| 100,000 | floor divide | 4.76 ms | 17.76 ms | **3.73× faster** |
| 100,000 | sqrt | 2.72 ms | 8.27 ms | **3.04× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | add | 25.50 µs | 84.12 µs | **3.30× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | multiply | 23.37 ms | 365.69 ms | **15.65× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | floor divide | 117.24 ms | 734.83 ms | **6.27× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | sqrt | 70.07 ms | 336.78 ms | **4.81× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.30 µs | 47.46 µs | 40.88 µs | 31.67 µs |
| 1,000 | 65.96 µs | 94.21 µs | 66.00 µs | 170.29 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.29 ms | 862.75 µs | 674.58 µs | 5.69 ms |
| 100,000 | 34.54 ms | 15.19 ms | 22.54 ms | 182.74 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 819.63 ms | 261.93 ms | 412.92 ms | 8.320 s |
